name: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore (Runtime / Code Interpreter / Browser)

modes.label: Code Interpreter session (container; active CPU + peak memory)
modes.note: Price List API: CodeInterpreter:Consumption-based:vCPU $0.0895/vCPU-h, Memory $0.00945/GB-h; identical in all 14 commercial AgentCore regions (GovCloud +20%). CPU billed on actual consumption (I/O wait free); memory on peak consumed up to that second, 128 MB minimum. Fixed 2 vCPU/8 GB, 10 GB disk. Basis verified 2026-09-28: "For CPU resources, you are charged based on actual consumption - if your agent consumes no CPU during I/O wait, there are no CPU charges. For memory resources, you're charged for the peak memory consumed up to that second." ; "128MB minimum memory billing applies for memory" (https://aws.amazon.com/bedrock/agentcore/pricing/). RAM = peak (peak-to-date within the session), CPU = active, no CPU floor. Runtime v1 microVMs are billed on the identical meter ($0.0895/vCPU-h, $0.00945/GB-h, active CPU + peak memory, 2 vCPU/8 GB max); Runtime v1 is priced as its own mode runtime-v1 since 2026-09-28 (split for isolation/custom image; same rates).

modes.label: Runtime v1 microVM (same meter as Code Interpreter)
modes.note: Split from code-interpreter 2026-09-28. Pricing copied: pricing page lists Code Interpreter at "$0.0895 per vCPU-hour" and "$0.00945 per GB-hour", the same v1 rates as Runtime (https://aws.amazon.com/bedrock/agentcore/pricing/, rows v1 CPU $0.0895 per vCPU-hour, v1 Memory $0.00945 per GB-hour). Active CPU + peak memory, 128 MB memory minimum, 2 vCPU/8 GB max per session, sessions up to 8 h. Runs your own container image (ECR) or direct code deploy in a dedicated microVM per session.

modes.label: Runtime v2 consumption (idle memory reclaimed after 120 s)
modes.note: Runtime:Consumption-based:vCPU-v2 $0.1276, Memory-v2 $0.0169; SKUs only in us-east-1, us-east-2, us-west-2, eu-west-1, ap-northeast-1. 43%/79% higher unit rates than v1 but idle memory is reclaimed after 120 s. Basis verified 2026-09-28: "CPU scales to zero during I/O wait ... and with v2, memory is reclaimed throughout the session." ; "Idle memory is reclaimed automatically in Runtime v2 after 120 seconds" (https://aws.amazon.com/bedrock/agentcore/pricing/). CPU and RAM = active (average resident); 128 MB memory minimum not encoded (active_floor would also floor CPU).

modes.label: Runtime v2 committed baseline (announced, launching by Oct 2026)
modes.commit_note: Pricing page: "Committed baseline ... launching by October 2026". Term, minimum and purchase mechanics unpublished; modelled as an always-on allocated baseline.
modes.note: Not in the Price List API yet. Same unit rates as Lambda MicroVMs Graviton.

modes.label: Browser Tool session (1 vCPU / 4 GB)
modes.note: BrowserTool:Consumption-based:vCPU $0.0895, Memory $0.00945. Browser profiles billed at S3 Standard rates starting 2026-04-15 (Browser only). Basis verified 2026-09-28: "with AgentCore Browser you only pay for active resource consumption." ; "For memory resources, you're charged for the peak memory consumed up to that second." ; "I/O wait and idle time is free, if no other background process is running." (https://aws.amazon.com/bedrock/agentcore/pricing/). RAM = peak, CPU = active.

modes.label: Runtime Instances (EC2 in your account + 12% management fee)
modes.note: EC2 on-demand (us-east-1) + Runtime:Instance-based management fee from the Price List API (c7i.xlarge $0.02142 = 12%; G-series GPU 7.8%, e.g. g6.xlarge $0.062774). Sessions persist up to 14 days; up to 20 agents per capacity-provider session. EBS/IPv4 billed separately by EC2.

plans.name: Pay-as-you-go
plans.note: Code Interpreter/Browser: 1,000 concurrent sessions (adjustable). Runtime: 5,000 active sessions in us-east-1/us-west-2, 2,500 elsewhere; 25 new sessions/s; 8 h max lifetime; 15 min idle timeout.

features.ip_note: Browser egresses from rotating AWS IPs; bring-your-own HTTP/HTTPS proxy per session (max 5, no SOCKS, no rotation) or VPC mode; no AWS-sold residential proxies.

caveats: Runtime v2 committed baseline ($0.0997/vCPU-h + $0.0132/GB-h) is announced as 'launching by October 2026'; term, minimum and purchase mechanics unpublished, so it is opt-in only (flag sales).
Rates verified in the AWS Price List API (AmazonBedrockAgentCore, publication 2026-09-15) and the pricing page (2026-09-28).

Active-CPU billing: cpu_basis active with no floor; I/O wait (LLM calls) is free only if no background process burns CPU. Memory: Code Interpreter, Browser and Runtime v1 use ram_basis peak (peak consumed up to that second, i.e. peak-to-date in the session), so the workload's peak RAM input drives the bill; Runtime v2 reclaims idle memory after 120 s and uses ram_basis active. The old peak_mem_frac knob was removed (the engine's peak RAM input replaces it). 128 MB memory minimum not encoded.
Runtime v2 committed baseline is announced only ("launching by October 2026"); mechanics unknown, flagged beta.
A single session maxes at 2 vCPU/8 GB (Browser 1 vCPU/4 GB), so a 4 vCPU workload does not fit consumption modes.
The pricing page Instances example cites "c7g.2xlarge $0.867 x 0.12"; c7g.2xlarge on-demand is $0.29 in us-east-1 and the API fee is $0.0348 (= 12% of $0.29). The page example looks wrong.

Other AgentCore meters (not modelled): Gateway $0.005/1k invocations, search $0.025/1k, $0.0002 per tool-index-month; Memory short-term $0.25/1k events, long-term $0.75/1k records-month (built-in) or $0.25 (custom), retrieval $0.50/1k; Web Search tool $7/1k queries; Knowledge Base $1/1k retrievals; Evaluations per token.
Storage: direct-code deployments at S3 Standard rates; container images in ECR. No snapshots/pause for consumption sessions.

Network: "standard EC2 data transfer rates"; Internet egress (AWS Price List API, AWSDataTransfer us-east-1, 2026-09): first 100 GB/month free aggregated across all services and regions, then $0.09/GB first 10 TB, $0.085 next 40 TB, $0.07 next 100 TB, $0.05 over 150 TB. eu-west-1 is also $0.09; ap-south-1 $0.1093; ap-northeast-1 $0.114; ap-southeast-1 $0.12 (first-10-TB tier). The engine uses the flat us-east-1 first tier.
AWS Free Tier $200 credit for new accounts is generic; no AgentCore-specific free quota.

Runtime v1 (microVM, custom container image) and Code Interpreter (containerized, AWS-managed images) share the same v1 meter but are separate modes (runtime-v1 / code-interpreter). Runtime v2 reclaims idle memory at higher unit rates.

fleet.verification: Personal details, email and phone; payment card may be required.
fleet.tiers: Browser/Code Interpreter: 1,000 concurrent sessions each; Runtime: 5,000 in us-east-1/us-west-2, 2,500 elsewhere.
fleet.notes: Regional service defaults, not reserved capacity. Instance field represents tool sessions; Runtime has a separate quota. Support ticket/Service Quotas for increases; no published typical review time.
